benchmark: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker — fixed Game 2 Gauntlet references
verificationMethod: Recovered each imageUrl from an ImageObject contentUrl in the official product page, downloaded the CDN response, and verified byte-for-byte identity by SHA-256 against the previously reviewed local JPEG. Independently decoded both images to verify dimensions. Repeated retrieval with Accept: image/jpeg and confirmed the same hashes.
identityPolicy: Both listed SHA-256 hashes and dimensions are fixed. A failed download or any hash or dimension mismatch blocks a valid benchmark comparison; do not substitute another frame, re-encode the reference, change its expected hash, or lower the quality bar.
storagePolicy: Retrieve reference images into temporary storage outside the repository. Commit only this provenance metadata, never the Nintendo image bytes or derivatives containing those bytes.

references.sceneDescription: Golden sandstone miniature temple with blue ladders, two upper archways, large green stone blocks, expressive spiked block enemies, pressure switches, a star at upper left, and Toadette on the right ladder. The HUD shows 27 coins.

Captain Toad stands on a low stone platform in a reflective turquoise water channel beside grassy banks and a sandstone tower doorway, under an orange sky. Three large gold coins rise above the foreground-right platform. The HUD shows 10 coins and one filled gem slot.
